name: darkhorse-mcp
description: DarkHorse MCP Knowledge Service — grounded SAP knowledge tools that eliminate hallucinated SAP references in code generation

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build

notes.purpose: CPI-6 Sprint 1: MCP server scaffold + verification tools. Eliminates hallucinated SAP exits/BAdIs from generated code by giving agents a grounded SAP knowledge service to query before referencing any SAP object.
notes.no-native-modules: This package deliberately contains NO native npm modules — pure JS only. Static JSON catalogs back all tools in Sprint 1.
notes.transport: HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1 only — same security model as llm-proxy. JSON request/response per tool endpoint. Migrates to full MCP protocol (stdio or HTTP+SSE) in a later sprint.
notes.catalog-source-of-truth: catalog/*.json files seed Sprint 1 knowledge. Sprint 2 replaces these with Azure AI Search queries against the Cloudification Repository + SAP API Hub.
future-sprints: Sprint 2: Replace static catalogs with Azure AI Search RAG queries
Sprint 3-5: Wire SO/FDS/TDS/Code agents to call these tools before generating
Sprint 6: Correction Store + Review Agent feedback loop
